title: Network health degraded

definition.name: [Lustre] Network health degraded
definition.message:
Lustre network health is degraded (health value < 900, normal is 1000).

This indicates potential issues with:
* Network connectivity
* Hardware problems (cables, switches, NICs)
* Driver issues
* Network congestion
* Remote peer connectivity

{{#is_alert}}
Health value: {{value}} (1000 = perfect health)
Network interface: {{local_nid.name}}
{{/is_alert}}

Immediate actions:
1. Check network interface status and logs
2. Verify physical network connections
3. Test connectivity to remote peers
4. Check for driver or firmware issues
5. Monitor for network errors and timeouts
